start.name: The Ashen Wastes — Entry
start.description: Adamus is here, somehow. He looks unsurprised.
start.atmosphere: Adamus the Loyal has set up shop here. Use 'shop' to trade.

floor1_room1.name: The Hot Stone Passage
floor1_room1.description: Passage where the floor radiates heat through your boots.
floor1_room1.atmosphere: The heat has a direction. It's pointing at something.

floor1_room2.name: The Burned Archive
floor1_room2.description: An archive where every record has burned except the ash.
floor1_room2.atmosphere: The ash forms legible words if you look long enough.

floor1_room3.name: The Cinder Barracks
floor1_room3.description: Soldiers' quarters melted into one another.
floor1_room3.atmosphere: The soldiers remain. In a technical sense.

floor1_room4.name: The Scorched Gate
floor1_room4.description: The entrance burned so completely the stone is glass.
floor1_room4.atmosphere: It still radiates heat. It will never stop.

floor1_room5.name: The Ash Field
floor1_room5.description: A vast field of ash with no visible source.
floor1_room5.atmosphere: The ash moves against the (nonexistent) wind.

floor1_room6.name: The Soot Hall
floor1_room6.description: Soot two inches thick on every surface.
floor1_room6.atmosphere: Footprints in the soot. They lead deeper in.

floor1_room7.name: The Ember Garden
floor1_room7.description: A garden where the flowers are made of compressed ember.
floor1_room7.atmosphere: They're beautiful. They're also on fire.

floor1_room8.name: The Char Corridor
floor1_room8.description: A corridor made of charred wood that should have collapsed.
floor1_room8.atmosphere: It hasn't. Something is holding it up.

floor1_boss.name: The Scorched Gate
floor1_boss.description: The entrance has been on fire for so long it forgot how to stop.
floor1_boss.atmosphere: The Cinder King steps from the flame.

floor3_start.name: The Ashen Wastes — Floor 3
floor3_start.atmosphere: Adamus the Loyal has set up shop here. Use 'shop' to trade.

floor3_room1.name: The Cinder Library
floor3_room1.description: Books burned to the shapes of books. Holding ash.
floor3_room1.atmosphere: One book still has pages. The words are warnings.

floor3_room2.name: The Pyro Hall
floor3_room2.description: Cultist meeting space, still set up for a meeting.
floor3_room2.atmosphere: The candles are lit. Someone set them recently.

floor3_room3.name: The Ember Crypt
floor3_room3.description: Crypts where the dead burned before burial was needed.
floor3_room3.atmosphere: The burning continues. The dead continue.

floor3_room4.name: The Last Market
floor3_room4.atmosphere: The merchants are still waiting on payment.

floor3_room5.name: The Glass Throne Room
floor3_room5.description: The heat fused everything to glass. The throne is beautiful.
floor3_room5.atmosphere: The throne is occupied. What sits in it is not glass.

floor3_room6.name: The Cinder Armory
floor3_room6.description: Weapons that survived because they were already metal.
floor3_room6.atmosphere: They've been reforged by heat into something better or worse.

floor3_room7.name: The Ash Cathedral
floor3_room7.description: Dedicated to the principle of fire. Very serious about it.
floor3_room7.atmosphere: The congregation is still here. Ash takes interesting forms.

floor3_room8.name: The Slag Gallery
floor3_room8.description: Portraits melted to slag, faces still visible in the metal.
floor3_room8.atmosphere: The expressions are wrong for paintings. Too alive.

floor3_boss.name: The Char Chamber
floor3_boss.description: Everything in here has burned. Some of it is burning still.
floor3_boss.atmosphere: The Char Warden rises from the ash.

floor4_boss.description: A throne room with a throne made of cooled lava over old bones.
floor4_boss.atmosphere: The Slag Queen flows from the cracks in the floor.

floor5_start.name: The Ashen Wastes — Floor 5
floor5_start.atmosphere: Adamus the Loyal has set up shop here. Use 'shop' to trade.

floor5_room1.name: The Magma Chamber
floor5_room1.description: The heart of the volcano that decided to become a dungeon.
floor5_room1.atmosphere: The magma has opinions and occasionally expresses them.

floor5_room2.name: The Cinder Forge
floor5_room2.description: A forge that runs on something other than bellows.
floor5_room2.atmosphere: The something is angry and very hot.

floor5_room3.name: The Fire Nexus
floor5_room3.description: Every flame in the Ashen Wastes connects here.
floor5_room3.atmosphere: You can hear them all burning simultaneously.

floor5_room4.name: The Cooling Field
floor5_room4.description: Lava that cooled too fast and created a field of black glass.
floor5_room4.atmosphere: The glass shows reflections of things not present.

floor5_room5.name: The Ember Field
floor5_room5.description: Embers the size of houses, drifting upward slowly.
floor5_room5.atmosphere: The source of the embers is below you.

floor5_room6.name: The Ash Sea
floor5_room6.description: A sea of fine ash that moves like water.
floor5_room6.atmosphere: Things swim in it. You can see their fins.

floor5_room7.name: The Heat Cathedral
floor5_room7.description: The real place of worship in the Ashen Wastes.
floor5_room7.atmosphere: The idol is just fire. But it responds to prayer.

floor5_room8.name: The Lava Bridge
floor5_room8.description: A stone bridge over a sea of lava that never cooled.
floor5_room8.atmosphere: The bridge is holding. For now. The lava is patient.

floor5_boss.name: The Pyroclast Field
floor5_boss.description: The remnants of an eruption that never fully finished.
floor5_boss.atmosphere: The Infernal Titan solidifies from the ejecta.

floor7_start.name: The Ashen Wastes — Floor 7
floor7_start.atmosphere: Adamus the Loyal has set up shop here. Use 'shop' to trade.

floor7_room1.name: The Last Light
floor7_room1.description: The only light source in this section that isn't fire.
floor7_room1.atmosphere: It has been here since before the fire. It remembers the before.

floor7_room2.name: The Eternal Flame Hall
floor7_room2.description: Flames that have not been extinguished for millennia.
floor7_room2.atmosphere: They recognise you. This is bad.

floor7_room3.name: The Cinder Abyss
floor7_room3.atmosphere: The burning darkness drops further than physics allows.

floor7_room4.name: The Incineration Chamber
floor7_room4.description: Designed to burn things. Currently burning.
floor7_room4.atmosphere: The things it's burning look back at you.

floor7_room5.name: The Heat Void
floor7_room5.description: Heat so intense it has eaten the space around it.
floor7_room5.atmosphere: Moving through this room takes more steps than it should.

floor7_room6.name: The Pyre Core
floor7_room6.description: The original pyre from which everything spread.

floor7_room7.name: The Char Sanctum
floor7_room7.description: A sanctum of ash and char that has become something holy.

floor7_room8.name: The Sacrificial Kiln
floor7_room8.description: Built for something larger and older than sacrifice.

floor7_boss.name: The Burning Court
floor7_boss.description: The court of someone who believed fire was the answer to everything.
floor7_boss.atmosphere: The Burning Prince takes their charred throne.

floor9_start.name: The Ashen Wastes — Floor 9
floor9_start.atmosphere: Adamus the Loyal has set up shop here. Use 'shop' to trade.

floor9_room1.name: The Pyroclast Hall
floor9_room1.description: A hall made from the hardened ejecta of the origin eruption.
floor9_room1.atmosphere: The walls show the history of fire in cross-section.

floor9_room2.name: The Origin Vent
floor9_room2.description: The vent from which the first fire emerged.

floor9_room3.name: The Last Fire
floor9_room3.description: This is where fire ends. Or starts. Depends on direction.
floor9_room3.atmosphere: You are going the wrong direction.

floor9_room4.name: The Primordial Hearth
floor9_room4.description: The first fire ever lit, still going.
floor9_room4.atmosphere: Everything that ever burned traces back to here.

floor9_room5.name: The Final Ember
floor9_room5.description: One ember. The last. The one that would end everything if it went out.
floor9_room5.atmosphere: You are not allowed to extinguish it.

floor9_room6.name: The Burning Throne Approach
floor9_room6.description: The approach to the burning throne. The heat is personal here.
floor9_room6.atmosphere: The heat specifically targets you. This is intentional.

floor9_room7.name: The Ash Observatory
floor9_room7.description: An observatory looking out onto nothing but ash.
floor9_room7.atmosphere: The ash forms constellations. They are not friendly ones.

floor9_room8.name: The Cinder Core
floor9_room8.description: The core of the Ashen Wastes. Everything else is aftermath.

floor9_boss.name: The Pyre Core
floor9_boss.description: The source of all the fire. Still going.
floor9_boss.atmosphere: The Eternal Pyre opens its eyes. They are made of the oldest flame.
